title: Trust signals, pricing, FAQ and policies

sections.skill: Add honest trust signals, prices, an FAQ and policies

questions.prompt: Which is an honest trust signal?

choices.text: Stock photos labeled as the owner's own completed work
Made-up five-star reviews written by the owner herself
A "Best in the World" badge the owner designed for herself

questions.intro: Visitors need reasons to trust a new business. TRUST SIGNALS include real contact details, a short "about" section with a real person, genuine reviews used with permission, photos of actual work, and clear policies. Showing PRICES (or a starting price) saves everyone time. An FAQ (frequently asked questions) answers common worries such as delivery time or what happens if something goes wrong. Posting refund, privacy and shipping policies before purchase sets expectations. Never invent reviews or badges.
